They are in OOPS #1's x8 = 0xffff000195f6e510 (Comm: bash, __d_lookup_rcu).
That dump (lines 58970-59003) is appended verbatim at the end of this file.
Fragments decoded (little-endian):
  "pamc"+"hann"+"el.1"+".gz"  -> pamchannel.1.gz
  "pamc"+"omp."+"1.gz"        -> pamcomp.1.gz
  "pamc"+"rate"+"r.1."+"gz"   -> pamcrate.1.gz
  "pamc"+"ut.1"+".gz"         -> pamcut.1.gz
  "pamd"+"eint"+"erla"+"ce.1" -> pamdeinterlace.1
These are netpbm man-page filenames: stale dcache/slab residue reused as the
tbtun rx buffer, i.e. the buffer was NOT zero-initialised before parsing.
